- Log retention/export: David will share the runbook and an example export (sanitized) during the meeting.
- Host keys: high level answer — host SSH keys are centrally managed and restricted to infra ops; we’ll clarify role boundaries and KMS usage on the call.

- Marissa: prepare the CAIQ mapping and an index of artifacts we can drop into a shared folder.
- David: extract a small sanitized log sample and a short diagram of the logging pipeline.

Thanks — see you Wed.
